`./compile.sh` reports success (`compiled OK`), producing `out/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.class`.

## What was delivered

`tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 3.8 test (`extends junit.framework.TestCase`, matching `lib/junit-3.8.1.jar`; no `org.junit.*`, no helper/base classes). It's in package `org.apache.commons.csv` so it can call the package-private `validate()` documented in the javadoc, and can name the (undocumented-but-referenced) `Quote` / `CSVParser` types.

Coverage, all grounded in `api/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormat.html`:

- **`newFormat(char)`** — sets the delimiter; leaves every other option unset (quote/escape/comment/nullString/header disabled); rejects `'\n'` and `'\r'` with `IllegalArgumentException`.
- **Predefined formats** — asserts the documented settings of `DEFAULT`, `RFC4180`, `EXCEL`, `TDF`, `MYSQL` (delimiter, quote char, record separator CRLF/LF, `TDF` space-trimming, `MYSQL` backslash escape + unquoted, `DEFAULT` empty-line skipping vs. plain `RFC4180`).
- **`with*` methods** — each returns a new instance with the new value while the receiver is unchanged (immutability), including a sweep over the whole `with*` family via `assertNotSame` + receiver-state checks.
- **`Character` overloads** — `null` disables quoting/escaping/commenting (incl. clearing `MYSQL`'s escape); line-break arguments throw `IllegalArgumentException` (both `char` and `Character` forms).
- **Getters vs. `is*`** — `isQuoting`/`isEscaping`/`isCommentingEnabled`/`isNullHandling` track their configured chars/strings.
- **`getHeader()`** — user names round-trip; defensive copy (mutating the result doesn't affect the format, distinct arrays per call); no-arg `withHeader()` yields an empty non-null array; `null` when unset.
- **`equals`/`hashCode`** — reflexive, rejects `null` and foreign types, value-based, `DEFAULT ≠ RFC4180`, hashCode consistent with equals.
- **`format(Object...)`** — joins with the delimiter, honours a custom delimiter, RFC 4180 quoting of delimiter-containing fields, quote-doubling, `nullString` on output, empty-input boundary.
- **`parse(Reader)`** — non-null `CSVParser` for valid and empty input.
- **`validate()`** — passes for all predefined formats; throws `IllegalStateException` when the delimiter collides with the quote/escape/comment character.
- **`getQuotePolicy`/`withQuotePolicy`** — round-trip.
